svg.aria-label: The state X(t) = Φ(z(t)) of the smoothed octagon for t in [0, t_f], as a path in the upper half-plane inside the star domain ρ₀, ρ₁, ρ₂ > 0 (shaded), the ideal triangle with vertices −1/√3, 1/√3 and ∞. From z(0) = i y₀ it runs along a line through −1/√3 under e₃ (green), a circle through ±1/√3 under e₁ (orange), a line through 1/√3 under e₂ (purple), and the first line again under e₃: z(t_f) = R⁻¹·z(0), the twisted boundary condition X(t_f) = R⁻¹X(0)R. R fixes i
